To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in, so that is £1,271.75 each between the four of us, same split as always. Please can you pay me by 31 January into the usual account. The park wants the full amount by then.

If anyone would rather pay in two lots, that's fine. £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just let me know.

The park fee has gone up again, about £350 on last year. There's nothing I can do about it, the park sets it.

The weeks for 2027 are:

Me and Bev 5 to 12 June, handover on the 5th.
Pete and Linda 29 May to 5 June.
Jan 7th to 14th August.
Carol Easter week and a week in September.

No clashes this year, so everyone should be sorted.

Pete mentioned the shower tray. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in, parts were £140. I'm not putting that on the bill, it's done.

Two reminders. Please make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned about it again. Also, the park says any caravan over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. The van is 16 years old, so it's worth knowing now so nobody's surprised next year.

Any problems let me know.

Mick
